card: Updates the help string for the `-ipcbind` option to document how to set options on the default Unix domain socket path using `unix:,max-connections=8`. Users previously had no documentation in the help text explaining that the colon after unix is required when supplying options without an explicit path. This addresses issue #36657.
changed_since_previous: No functional changes to the patch; includes a merge commit from master.
evidence: Addresses issue #36657: 'Clarify -ipcbind syntax when using max-connections with the default Unix socket'
problem: Users configuring IPC on Bitcoin nodes lacked guidance in `-help` on how to specify options such as `max-connections` for the default Unix socket path, leading to confusion because a trailing colon is required before the comma.

risk.why: It only modifies a user-facing help string.

summary: Updates the `-ipcbind` command-line help text in `src/init.cpp` to include an example for configuring options like `max-connections` while keeping the default Unix domain socket path (`unix:,max-connections=8`). It explicitly notes that the colon after `unix:` is required when appending options without a custom path.
